title: Topical Investigations; Government and Politics of Latin America
description: This is a GVPT Global Learning offering. This course examines key political, social, and economic policies in contemporary Latin America with an emphasis on Cuba. The course will meet on campus during the Fall semester and then complete a week long trip to Cuba over the 2023 Winter Break. Students must complete both GVPT388D and the Winter Break study abroad GVPT388E.
